reason: As a solo practitioner who has strictly avoided cloud platforms over data leak paranoia, I will not purchase an annual subscription until I personally verify that connecting our Google Drive does not expose confidential ROC, PAN, and ITR documents. I would only evaluate the free pilot first to confirm the folder isolation and restore safeguards under actual working conditions.
objection: If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder, and can Docketra truly restore it instantly without any corruption or data loss?
would_change_my_mind: Extensively testing the free pilot to independently verify that Docketra is strictly quarantined to its folder and that accidental folder deletions or moves can be flawlessly recovered without risking client confidentiality.
